name: Hu tieu
summary: Hủ tiếu is Can Tho’s breakfast noodle soup, passed from boat to boat at Cái Răng at dawn. The broth is pork bone and dried squid with star anise and ginger, poured over chewy noodles and bean sprouts; other bowls come with tapioca noodles, sliced pork, and herbs.
origin: Cái Răng and the noodle workshops toward Phong Điền. This is Can Tho’s own breakfast bowl, not the Ho Chi Minh City hủ tiếu.
howToEat: Order it at dawn on the water, when the bowl is handed across from the noodle boat.
Drink a cà phê vợt from the coffee boat with it.
where: The noodle workshops toward Phong Điền, where the sheets are made.
seoDescription: Hủ tiếu from the Cái Răng breakfast boats: pork-bone and dried-squid broth with star anise, ginger, chewy noodles, and bean sprouts.
texture: Chewy noodles with bean sprouts in a pork-bone and dried-squid broth.
The tapioca-noodle bowl adds sliced pork and herbs.
